name: 1 - Managed Netskope URL List - Ingest
description: Ingest URLs from Netskope Policy ID into TI Feed module

schema.title: Keystore value to be configured
schema.description:
You need to create a keystore value named: 
#### **{{vars.keystore_name}}** 
into KeyStore with the following format:

```
[
  {
    "id": value,
    "name": "string",
    "feedName": "netskope-id",
    "durationIp": 1,
    "DurationUrl": 7
  }
]
```

or you can execute the playbook named **Managed Netskope URL List - Configure**
